plugins.name: eslint-plugin-browser-security

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-node-security
plugins.description: ESLint Node security rules for Node.js — detects command injection, path traversal, SSRF, zip slip, and weak crypto (MD5/SHA-1, ECB, static IV) in fs, child_process, vm, and crypto

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-secure-coding
